observation_likelihood_comparison.description: Observation-level loss comparison with cluster-robust sandwich variance (clustered by coordinate group)
observation_likelihood_comparison.methodological_caveat: A group-level accuracy t-test must NOT be used as evidence of an MCC difference. Accuracy evaluates unweighted 0/1 correctness, whereas MCC evaluates correlation across all four contingency matrix quadrants. The paired cluster-bootstrap on MCC directly tests the metric of interest.
